title: Deep Learning Artificial Intelligence Predicts Homologous Recombination Deficiency and Platinum Response From Histologic Slides.
summary: DeepHRD used weakly supervised CNNs on H&E slides to predict homologous-recombination deficiency and platinum response across breast/ovarian cancer cohorts, with held-out and external-cohort evaluation.
ai_technology: whole-slide tiling and weak labels; Results report held-out HRD prediction and external outcome associations.
